versions.changelog:
pdd-coupon-bot 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Automatically finds hidden coupons, big discounts, and subsidy deals on Pinduoduo to help users save money.
- Supports all product categories with features like coupon search, historical price tracking, and low-price recommendations.
- Provides tips for stacking multiple coupon types and showcases sample savings cases.
- Offers a pricing plan with free and paid options.
- Includes a detailed FAQ, usage guide, and customer support contact information.
